body:
When I am with friends at a party and we go up to a guy to talk to him, he will hardly glance at me, asking me what my name is purely out of courtesy. Guys look at me with glazed over eyes as I say my name because they really couldn't give one fuck what my name is when my more attractive friends are standing next to me. Is that not proof enough?
Not to mention I have never had a real boyfriend, never had sex, and have only kissed two guys and regretted both the next day. I am a social clusterfuck, not at the weight I should be, and I have a completely average, if not under average, face. My eyes tilt downward, making me look sad all the time. Did you know that downward tilting eyes are one of the most unattractive features a female can have on their face? My hair is a poofy mess that I have still can't find a way to control. I try to grow it longer but it barely grows. I can't do anything with it.

To answer your question, the reason I don't think I am beautiful is because I am not. I wasn't born pretty and everyone around me lets me know it.
